name: Builder
summary: Separates the construction of a complex object from its representation, so that the same construction process can produce different representations.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Builder
roles.summary: Declares the step by step construction operations.

roles.name: ConcreteBuilder
roles.summary: Implements the construction steps and keeps track of the representation it builds.

roles.name: Director
roles.summary: Drives the construction sequence through the builder interface.
